title: compat: backfill empty PortBindings and warn for API >= 1.52
body:
Mirror moby's handlePortBindingBC a container port with an empty list of port bindings is treated as a single binding with an unspecified HostIP/HostPort, matching Docker's behavior. For API >= 1.52 return Docker's deprecation warning in the create response

Fixes: #30326
